item.name: Dinghy
item.howToGet: Free on Fisherman Island (Fisherman's Hut after rescue; also reported from island chests). Can be crafted or bought from the MukuMuku merchant.
item.cardSummary: Best first boat for most runs. Faster than the Raft, seats three, hauls items, and is often free once you hit Fisherman Island.
item.notes: Craft recipe cost is not confirmed in public boat guides. Prefer the free Fisherman path over crafting early.

item.name: Raft
item.howToGet: Craftable from the raft crafting table.
item.cardSummary: Slow starter boat that can haul items for one player. Drop it as soon as the free Dinghy is available.
item.notes: Craft recipe cost is not confirmed in public boat guides. Guides consistently recommend skipping it for the Dinghy.

item.name: UFO
item.howToGet: Alien Overlord class starter, or found on the UFO alien island.
item.cardSummary: Fastest boat in the game. Stays as an inventory item you equip on demand, so it is always with you for pure island hopping.
item.notes: Only boat that equips from inventory instead of placing on water. Cannot haul items, seats one, and cannot be used in dungeons. Equipping under a structure spawns the UFO above it.

item.name: Jetski
item.howToGet: Craft at the crafting table, or buy from the MukuMuku merchant.
item.cardSummary: Fastest craftable boat and the best everyday solo travel pick when you do not have a UFO. Great for scouting; no cargo seat.
item.notes: Also spelled Jetsky in some community pages. Merchant Doubloon price is not listed in public boat guides.

item.name: Yacht
item.howToGet: Craft at the crafting table, or buy from the MukuMuku merchant.
item.cardSummary: Mid-speed hauler for teams that need to move people and loot together. Often skipped in pure solo play for a faster non-cargo boat.
item.notes: Merchant Doubloon price is not listed in public boat guides.

item.name: Galleon
item.howToGet: Craftable, or drop from the green chest on the Ghost Galleon after clearing enemies during Ghost Raids / the summoned galleon route.
item.cardSummary: Largest crew boat with six seats and item haul. Slow and huge, so it shines for group hauls more than solo island chains.
item.notes: Craft recipe cost is not confirmed in public boat guides. The Ghost Galleon structure itself is not a player boat—only the green-chest Galleon item is.

item.name: Massive Luxury Yacht
item.howToGet: Millionaire class exclusive starter (also called Jumbo Luxury Yacht or Luxury Yacht in class guides).
item.cardSummary: Class-only luxury boat tied to Millionaire. Useful for early travel and economy starts, but public guides do not publish firm speed or cargo stats.
item.notes: Speed, cargo, and passenger values are unknown in dedicated boat guides. Do not invent numbers. Alias names: Jumbo Luxury Yacht, Luxury Yacht.
